fix(semaphore): Fix semaphore reopens after forget

## Motivation  Closes https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/issues/8020  Current `forget_semaphores` doesn't consider LSB (Least Significant Bit), which is used to store semaphore open or closed, which leads to a weird behavior that semaphore reopens.  ## Solution  This PR sets the "closed" bit on `forget_semaphores`, another alternative I considered is to return error on close, but that seems
